Submit a review for a specific seller listing (CompanyProductVariant).

IMPORTANT: The route param is the CPV id (integer), NOT the product variant id.
Reviews are seller-specific — the same product variant sold by two different sellers has separate review lists.

Throttled to 2 requests per minute.
Authentication is optional — guests can submit reviews too.

The review is NOT visible publicly until an admin approves it.

Price ranges are returned in AZN (converted from cents).

query.description: filled --- date, title, price --- default date

request.description:
Returns a paginated list of active, approved CompanyProductVariant (seller listings).

Each card in the response represents ONE seller's listing for a product variant.
Multiple sellers can sell the same variant — each appears as a separate card.

Available filters (all optional):
  search            — full-text search on product title/description
  brands[]          — filter by brand slug(s)
  categories[]      — filter by parent category slug(s)
  sub_categories[]  — filter by sub-category slug(s)
  statuses[]        — on_sale | new_arrival | ...
  min_price / max_price — price in AZN (stored in cents, filter in AZN)
  sort              — date | title | price
  sort_type         — asc | desc
  is_set            — yes | no
  city_id           — filter by seller's city
  seller_store_code — filter by seller's 5-char store code
  limit             — 5-100, default 10
  page              — pagination page

Response: uuid field = CPV.uuid (used as seller param on detail page)

request.description:
Returns all reviews for every product belonging to the authenticated seller's company.
Read-only — sellers cannot approve, reject, or delete reviews.
Approval is managed exclusively by the admin panel.

Response fields per review:
  id, product_variant { id, uuid, slug, product { title } },
  name, surname, rating, review, created_at, is_approved, approved_at

variable.description: CompanyProductVariant id — must belong to the authenticated seller's company. Returns 403 otherwise.

request.description:
Returns reviews for one specific seller listing (CompanyProductVariant).
Throws 403 if the CPV does not belong to the authenticated company.

item.description:
Reviews are at the CompanyProductVariant (seller listing) level — each seller listing has its own independent reviews and ratings.
This allows calculating a per-seller average rating in the future.
Sellers can only VIEW their reviews; approval/deletion is admin-only.
